description: Who the threads matching a query come from: per sending domain, busiest first, the thread and unread counts, the newest and oldest date, and its busiest addresses. The starting point for sorting a mailbox into labels and filters. A thread's sender is the author of its latest message you did not send. One mailbox per call. A few hundred threads take seconds; past that Gmail's quota allows about 25 threads a second, so a 3000-thread inbox takes about two minutes.

account.description: Which registered mailbox: a label from list_accounts; empty means the default account.

limit.description: Threads scanned at most; `more` says whether the query matched more.

query.description: Gmail query syntax; default the inbox.

top.description: Domains listed; the rest are summed in otherDomains.

name: sender_breakdown
title: Sender breakdown
